name: Mortal Hunter
descr: An undead figure wearing a heavy leather coat, with searching eyes and a casually cruel demeanor.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Deathlock
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to curse a target within Very Close range with a necrotic _Deathlock_ until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a _Deathlocked_ target deal direct damage. The Hunter can only maintain one _Deathlock_ at a time.

features.name: Inevitable Death
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight **1d4** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Rampage
features.text: _Countdown (Loop 1d6)_. When the Hunter is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take **2d8+2** physical damage.
